info.title: Stocksmith API
info.description: REST API for reading materials, products, components, recipes, manufactures, expenses and inventory adjustments.

bearer_auth.description: Personal API key (live_...) passed as a Bearer token

subscription_plan.description: Subscription plan name, or null if none

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Return only components changed at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp, compared to the whole second (e.g. 2026-06-20T00:00:00Z; include a time zone), newest first. A component counts as changed when its details, stock counts or variations change (a variation's details or stock counts, or a variation being added or removed). Renaming a category, or a variation's attribute label or value, does not count. Pass state=all to include archived components. Removed components are not reported, so do a full read now and then. A malformed value returns 400.

get.description:
Inventory adjustments, oldest first. An inventory adjustment is one change to stock: starting stock, a purchase, a manufacture, a manual adjustment or a stocktake. Read one material's (`/materials/{id}/inventory_adjustments`), one component's (`/components/{id}/inventory_adjustments`) or the whole account's (`/inventory_adjustments`); the same filters work on all three.

Adjustments on the same day come in the order their balance was worked out, so in an unfiltered read of one material or component each `balance_after` is the one before plus `quantity`. `balance_after` is the running balance on the material's history tab. It counts purchases still on order, so the newest `balance_after` is the material's `stock_on_hand` plus its `on_order`.

Balances and costs are recalculated in the background after a change. After a change dated in the past they can be out of date for a while, longer on a material with a very long history.

These endpoints read adjustments by their date. They do not report adjustments that were deleted, a changed cost on an older adjustment, or an adjustment entered today for an earlier date. To find the materials and components whose stock, on-order quantity or cost changed, read `GET /api/v1/materials` and `GET /api/v1/components` with `updated_since` (and `state=all`), then read their adjustments for the dates you care about, and do a full read now and then. A read paged over time is not a snapshot: an adjustment entered, re-dated or removed while you page can repeat a row or skip one on a later page. `id` lets you drop repeats; nothing recovers a skip, so if `meta.total_count` changes between your first and last page, read the window again.

Read long histories in date windows, a month at a time. A read with no `from` and `to` on a very long history, or on the largest accounts, is slower, and its later pages slower still.

To read one material's or component's adjustments, use its own path: `material_id` and `component_id` are not filters on this one, and sending either returns 400 naming it.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Return adjustments on or after this ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2026-03-01), a day in the account's time zone. Once from or to is set, an adjustment stored without a date is never returned. A malformed value returns 400.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Return adjustments on or before this ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2026-03-31), the whole day included, in the account's time zone. A malformed value returns 400.

parameters.name: costed
parameters.description: true returns adjustments that carry a unit cost, false those with none. Stock added by an adjustment or a stocktake is costed at zero. Materials that are not inventoriable have no balance or cost and are left out of this filter. Any other value returns 400.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Comma-separated, one or more of: starting, purchase, manufacture, adjustment, stocktake. Any other value returns 400.

200.description: paginated list of the account's inventory adjustments

date.description: Day of the inventory adjustment in the account's time zone (`time_zone` on `GET /api/v1/account`). An adjustment stored without a date shows the account's start date.

adjuster.description: The record behind the adjustment: a purchase (its id is an expense id, `GET /api/v1/expenses/{id}`), a manufacture (`GET /api/v1/manufactures/{id}`) or a stocktake (not yet readable through the API). Null for starting stock and manual adjustments. For a component, `manufacture` covers both making it (positive `quantity`) and using it in another manufacture (negative).

quantity.description: Decimal string, stock units. Negative when stock went down

balance_after.description: Decimal string. The running balance after this adjustment, as the history tab shows it, counting purchases still on order. Null for materials that are not inventoriable.

received.description: False only for a purchase still on order

costed.description: True when the adjustment carries a unit cost. Null for materials that are not inventoriable.

unit_cost.description: Omitted for view-only users. Null for materials that are not inventoriable. For a purchase still on order it is the average cost at that point, not the price on the purchase.

component_id.description: The component's id on `/api/v1/components`. Null for a material's adjustments

category.description: Name of the adjustment category. Null for an adjustment without one, and for a category that has since been removed.

parameters.name: from

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter by start date on or before this ISO 8601 date (e.g. 2026-12-31). A malformed date is ignored, not rejected.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Return only manufactures changed at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp, compared to the whole second (e.g. 2026-06-20T00:00:00Z; include a time zone), newest first. A manufacture counts as changed when it or any of its line items change, including a re-cost after a purchase is edited. Renaming a material does not count. Removed manufactures are not reported, so do a full read now and then. A malformed value returns 400, unlike from and to, which are ignored when malformed.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by state. Defaults to 'active'. 'all' returns active + archived.

parameters.name: category_name
parameters.description: Partial category name filter (case-insensitive substring match)

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Return only materials changed at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp, compared to the whole second (e.g. 2026-06-20T00:00:00Z; include a time zone), newest first. A material counts as changed when its details, stock count, cost or on-order quantity change. Renaming a category or unit of measure does not count. Pass state=all to include archived materials. Removed materials are not reported, so do a full read now and then. A malformed value returns 400.

on_order.description: Decimal string, stock units (not purchase units)
